dict.string: Mac Handsfree needs calendar access for explicit calendar commands issued by the local agent.
Mac Handsfree needs reminders access for explicit reminders commands issued by the local agent.
Mac Handsfree needs contacts access for explicit contacts commands issued by the local agent.
Mac Handsfree sends Apple events only for explicit local agent commands targeting Apple applications.
Mac Handsfree changes system settings or power state only after an explicit planned command.
